result.title: Benchmarking Answer-Grounding Consistency in Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering
result.comment: Under review at ICASSP 2027. Code available at https://github.com/pingggg516/AESP-Evaluation
result.summary: In grounded remote sensing visual question answering, a model produces a textual answer and identifies relevant objects in the image as grounding evidence. Existing evaluations measure answer correctness and localization quality, but do not directly assess answer-grounding consistency. We propose the Answer-Evidence Support Protocol (AESP) to assess this consistency through evidence support: whether the grounding evidence supports the model's own answer. AESP applies task-specific rules to existence, counting, and comparison questions. We further construct the Grounded Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering (G-RSVQA) benchmark, containing 15,027 samples with questions, reference answers, and all related object-level annotations. Experiments on seven grounded vision--language models reveal failures of evidence support across all three question types. Up to 50.82% of correct answers in the evidence evaluation subset are not supported by the provided grounding evidence.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Answer-Evidence Support Protocol（AESP），对存在、计数、比较三类问题按规则判定 grounding evidence 是否支持模型自己的答案，并构建含 15,027 个样本的 G-RSVQA 基准，在七个 grounded VLM 上发现证据支持普遍失败，多达 50.82% 的正确回答缺少证据支持。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于多模态推理的诊断与基准类工作，直接回应「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」以及视觉证据筛选问题，其 answer-grounding consistency 分析可供核查 VLM 推理中的视觉旁路与证据使用；但限于遥感领域，需进一步确认其规则化判定能否迁移到通用 latent 推理评估。
